item.title: Added "ripgrep-all" ripgrep, but also search in PDFs, E-Books, Office documents, zip, tar.gz, etc.
item.description: rga is a line-oriented search tool that wraps ripgrep and lets you search for a regex in a multitude of file types: PDFs, E-Books, Office documents, zip and tar.gz archives, sqlite databases, movie subtitles and more.

item.title: Added "advcpmv" Progress bars for GNU cp and mv
item.description: A patch for the GNU cp and mv tools which adds a progress bar and provides some info on what's going on.

item.title: Added "Terminal RPN Calculator" An HP42S/HP48SX style calculator for the terminal
item.description: A simple terminal calculator in the style of an HP42S or HP48SX, written in pure Python. Without a fancy GUI but with a super functional TUI instead.

item.title: Added "zenith" In terminal graphical metrics for your *nix system
item.description: zenith is sort of like top or htop but with zoom-able charts, CPU, GPU, network and disk usage.

item.title: Added "wlsunset" Day/night gamma adjustments for Wayland
item.description: Day/night gamma adjustments for Wayland compositors supporting wlr-gamma-control-unstable-v1.

item.title: Added "wl-gammarelay" Dynamically change the color temperature and software brightness
item.description: A client and daemon for changing color temperature and brightness under Wayland via keybindings.

item.title: Added "wl-clipboard" Command-line copy/paste utilities for Wayland
item.description: wl-copy and wl-paste let you easily copy data between the Wayland clipboard and Unix pipes, sockets, files and so on.

item.title: Added "GNU Stow" A symlink farm manager and dotfile organizer
item.description: GNU Stow is a symlink farm manager which takes packages located in separate directories and makes them appear installed in the same place. Commonly used to organize dotfiles.

item.title: Added "bash simple curses" Create some windows on your terminal
item.description: Create simple ncurses-like windows in your terminal with bash. Useful for building small dashboards and status displays from shell scripts.

item.title: Added "Terminal Shell Clock" A large clock for your terminal
item.description: A large terminal shell clock written in Bash, with different styles and different colors.

item.title: Added "vit" Visual Interactive Taskwarrior
item.description: VIT is a lightweight, fast, curses-based full-screen terminal interface for Taskwarrior with vim-like keybindings.

item.title: Added "JiraTUI" A TUI for interacting with Atlassian Jira from your shell
item.description: JiraTUI lets you search, view, create, delete, update and clone Jira work items from your shell. Includes full-text search, adding comments, related tasks, attachments and more.

item.title: Added "bmm" Get to your bookmarks in a flash
item.description: bmm (bookmarks manager) stores your bookmarks locally and lets you quickly access, list, search and manage them through a CLI and a TUI.

item.title: Added "WezTerm" A GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer
item.description: WezTerm is a GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer written in Rust, configurable with Lua.

item.title: Added "kitty" A fast, feature-rich, cross-platform, GPU based terminal
item.description: kitty is a fast, feature-rich, cross-platform, GPU based terminal emulator. It supports tiling multiple windows, ligatures, true color, an image protocol and is extensible via "kittens".

item.title: Added "Ghostty" A fast, native, feature-rich terminal emulator
item.description: Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.

item.title: Added "foot" A fast, lightweight and minimalistic Wayland terminal emulator
item.description: foot is a fast, lightweight and minimalistic Wayland terminal emulator. It supports a server/client mode, sixel images, true color and font ligatures.

item.title: Added "Zellij" A terminal workspace with batteries included
item.description: Zellij is a terminal multiplexer and workspace with batteries included. It features a layout system, floating and stacked panes, session management and a WebAssembly plugin system.

item.title: Added "rofi" A window switcher, application launcher and dmenu replacement
item.description: rofi is a window switcher, application launcher, ssh dialog and dmenu replacement. It can be fully driven by the keyboard and extended with custom scripts.

item.title: Added "ShellCheck" A static analysis tool for shell scripts
item.description: ShellCheck is a GPLv3 tool that gives warnings and suggestions for bash/sh shell scripts. It points out typical beginner syntax issues, semantic problems and subtle caveats that can cause scripts to fail.

item.title: Added "Chawan" Text-mode web browser and pager for Unix-like systems
item.description: Chawan is a text-mode web browser and pager for Unix-like systems. It supports CSS, inline images, optional JavaScript, and protocols such as HTTP(S), FTP, Gopher and Gemini.

item.title: Added "Browsh" A modern text-based browser
item.description: Browsh is a fully-modern text-based browser. It renders anything that a modern browser can: HTML5, CSS3, JS, video and even WebGL. It can be run on a remote server and accessed via SSH/Mosh to significantly reduce bandwidth usage.

item.title: Added "magic-tape" An image supporting fuzzy finder YouTube client
item.description: magic-tape is an image supporting fuzzy finder command line interface YouTube client. Search, browse and watch videos and channels without leaving the terminal.

item.title: Added "vimiv" An image viewer with vim-like keybindings
item.description: vimiv is an image viewer with vim-like keybindings. It supports a thumbnail mode, a library browser, basic image editing and a command line with tab completion.

item.title: Added "ucollage" An extensible command line image viewer inspired by vim
item.description: ucollage is an extensible command line image viewer inspired by vim. It displays images in a grid layout directly in the terminal, with vim-like keybindings and custom commands.

item.title: Added "bagels" A powerful expense tracker that lives in your terminal
item.description: Bagels expense tracker is a TUI application where you can track and analyse your money flow, with convenience oriented features and a complete interface.

item.title: Added "posting" The modern API client that lives in your terminal
item.description: Posting is an HTTP client, not unlike Postman and Insomnia. As a TUI application, it can be used over SSH and enables efficient keyboard-centric workflows. Your requests are stored locally in simple YAML files, so they're easy to read and version control.

item.title: Added "iamb" A Matrix client for Vim addicts
item.description: iamb is a Matrix client written in Rust with Vim-style keys. It supports threads, spaces, e2ee, and more.

item.title: Added "aerc" a pretty good email client
item.description: aerc is an email client that runs in your terminal. It's highly efficient and extensible, perfect for the discerning hacker.

item.title: Added everything from the awesome-cli list
item.description: cli.club now contains every tool on the awesome-cli list (https://github.com/agarrharr/awesome-cli-apps) along with numerous other tools suggested by community members. This now makes cli.club the most comprehensive cli list on the internet. Thank you to all contributors.

item.title: Added "glicol-cli" cross-platform music live coding in terminal
item.description:
It's a command line interface that you can use for music live coding with Glicol.
It watches a file changes and then update the music in real-time.

item.title: Added "asak" A cross-platform audio recording/playback CLI tool with TUI, written in Rust
item.description: A cross-platform audio recording/playback CLI tool with TUI, written in Rust. The goal is to be an audio Swiss Army Knife (asak), like SoX but more interactive and fun.

item.title: Added "pls" a prettier and powerful ls(1) for the pros
item.description: pls is a prettier and powerful ls(1) for the pros.

item.title: Introducing pqc.club! Post-Quantum Cryptography Tools and Alternatives
item.description: A collection of the best Post-Quantum Cryptography Tools and Alternatives to switch from software using legacy encryption. Find us at https://pqc.club.

item.title: Added "lazygit" simple terminal UI for git commands
item.description: Lazygit is a simple terminal UI for git commands, written in Go with the gocui library. Lazygit enables you to have a feeling of Sourcetree but in a terminal-centric environment. Lazygit is fast and easy to use, you just need to call lazygit in your terminal inside a git repository.

item.title: Added "k9s" Kubernetes CLI To Manage Your Clusters In Style
item.description: K9s provides a terminal UI to interact with your Kubernetes clusters. The aim of this project is to make it easier to navigate, observe and manage your applications in the wild. K9s continually watches Kubernetes for changes and offers subsequent commands to interact with your observed resources.

item.title: Added "nb" A command line and local web note‑taking, bookmarking, archiving, and knowledge base application
item.description:
nb is a command line and local web note‑taking, bookmarking, archiving, and knowledge base application with:
plain text data storage, encryption, filtering, pinning, #tagging, and search, Git-backed versioning and syncing, Pandoc-backed conversion, [[wiki-style linking]], terminal and GUI web browsing, inline images, todos with tasks, global and local notebooks, organization with folders, customizable color themes, extensibility through plugins,
and more, in a single portable script.

item.title: Added "ntfy.sh" Send push notifications to your phone or desktop using PUT/POST
item.description: ntfy (pronounced "notify") is a simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. With ntfy, you can send notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts from any computer, without having to sign up or pay any fees. If you'd like to run your own instance of the service, you can easily do so since ntfy is open source.

item.title: Added "spotify-player" as spotify-tui is no longer maintained
item.description: A Spotify player in the terminal with full feature parity written in Rust. Considered a replacement for spotify-tui as it is no longer maintained.

item.title: Added "ytfzf" Find and watch youtube videos from the terminal
item.description: A POSIX script that helps you find Youtube videos (without API) and opens/downloads them using mpv/youtube-dl.

item.title: Added "qrcp" Transfer files over Wi-Fi
item.description: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.

item.title: Added "ncspot" Cross-platform ncurses Spotify client
item.description: ncspot is a ncurses Spotify client written in Rust using librespot. It is heavily inspired by ncurses MPD clients, such as ncmpc.

item.title: Added "Toxic" A Tox-based instant messaging and video chat client
item.description: Toxic is a client with an ncurses interface, written entirely in C. It has support for all basic features, as well as 1-on-1 audio/video chats, and is capable of working on bare-bones systems that lack graphical interfaces. Development is lead by Jfreegman.
